ask: what sets have I got, and what methods could run over them?
why: A two-read question, and it is in the suite because the coverage report said nothing was watching `read-sets` or `read-templates` — the two verbs that answer "what is there to work with". Both listings are small and neither has a filter, so there is nothing to get wrong except reaching past them: the failure watched for is the agent opening iterations or drafting one to find out what sets exist. Order is not asserted, because neither read depends on the other.
